name: ahepi-music
description: Tools for making narrated explainer films.

plugins.name: explainer-film
plugins.description: Make narrated, fact-checked explainer films for phone screens in a cinematic 2D+3D look, chapter by chapter, with calculators and a preflight check at every stage; places, sets and props built in Blender get real photographed surfaces, weeds and stones where they really grow, wear and believable construction by themselves, with batched variation rounds on rented cards.

plugins.name: painted-place
plugins.description: Build a place in Blender for the series' painted look the way the owner approved: one fresh builder gets the brief kit (the look page and reference pictures, traps, a measure tool, boards of real photographs per kind of place, a shelf of photographed surfaces) and a store of ready parts, tools and materials to pick from (photographed stone and brick where every piece shows its own part of the photographs, a Japanese garden's lanterns, basin, bridge, maples, pines, bamboo, tiled roofs, paper screens, verandas and slab paths, a sett road with its flags and kerbs along any curve, brick or stone walls that fill any plane, a duckboard walkway on a line, setts with their wear, kerbs, lapped boards with eaves, stonework, slate roofs with gutters and downpipes, soot, damp and weathering, shop fronts, dormers, dry-stone walls and hedges, puddles, tents, a field gun, huts, lamps, carts, barrows, the street's materials, and ground tools for wet ground, ruts of carts and motors, potholes, stones, grass, leaves and twigs), decides everything about the place itself, and the owner judges the picture. Nothing in the store places itself.
